executiveSummary: Multiple actively exploited vulnerabilities and real-world OT incidents elevate near-term risk to industrial operations. Key drivers this cycle include: exploited OT gateways, mass exploitation of ubiquitous web stacks, and nation-state pre-positioning via edge/IoT infrastructure. Exploitation in the wild of Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced (Node-RED HTTP auth bypass) is delivering backdoors on devices that commonly bridge IT and ICS networks; immediate patching and flow review are required. View Article EPICS Base network-parsing flaws (incl. potential RCE) impact widely deployed control systems frameworks; patch to 7.0.11+, restrict CA/pvAccess, and segment ICS from IT. CISA Advisory "PHP2Shell" (CVE-2026-109618/109619) is under active exploitation across internet-facing applications; patch now or deploy WAF virtual patches and hunt for web shells and lateral movement. CISA Alert Retail cold-chain incidents across multiple EU countries manipulated Danfoss refrigeration controller setpoints, forcing store closures-highlighting immediate OT exposure risks in small, networked facilities. View Article Nation-state activity continues to weaponize edge/IoT: China-nexus actors leverage covert SOHO/IoT proxy networks, while Russian actors target routers via SNMP/Smart Install; prioritize router hygiene, segmentation, and egress monitoring. CISA Joint Advisory CISA Joint Advisory Active edge-device exploitation (NetScaler ADC/Gateway; Ivanti Connect Secure) persists; patch immediately and perform appliance integrity checks before returning to service. JPCERT Advisory CERT-FR Alert

items: China-nexus covert networks leveraging compromised SOHO/IoT to mask ops and pre-position in CI. CISA Joint Advisory
Router exploitation for data theft and persistence linked to Russian FSB Center 16 via SNMP/SMI abuse. CISA Joint Advisory
Lazarus "Operation FlashHole" abuses DLL sideloading and GitHub/Dropbox C2; supply-chain adjacent risk. Kaspersky Report
Ransomware RaaS (Gunra, SafePay) exploiting edge devices and LOTL tooling; broad sector impact with potential OT cascade. Gunra Advisory SafePay Advisory

relevance: Direct OT devices impacted: Siemens IoT2050 gateways; retail refrigeration controllers; EPICS frameworks; OPC UA/Milo libraries. Perimeter and pivot vectors: PHP web stacks; NetScaler and Ivanti VPN appliances; router/SOHO fleets (SNMP, Smart Install); PeopleSoft HR portals. Observed OT outcomes: Temperature setpoint manipulation, store closures, heightened risk of ICS DMZ to control-network pivoting. Likely targets/sectors: Food & retail cold chain, water/wastewater, energy transmission, manufacturing, transportation/aviation, and government services. Exposure patterns: Internet-facing management services, weak router hygiene, legacy/EoL OT devices with default creds, shared IT/OT remote access.

items: EPICS Base: memory corruption/overflow (update to 7.0.11). CISA Advisory

NetScaler ADC/Gateway: unauth RCE (CVE-2026-88771/88772 etc.)-active exploitation observed. JPCERT Advisory
Ivanti Connect Secure: RCE, privilege escalation (CVE-2026-104935, -111357, -118527) under exploitation. CERT-FR Alert
OPC UA Eclipse Milo: multiple auth and info-disclosure issues impacting UA servers; prefer strong policies and patch. CISA Bulletin
Advantech WISE gateways: unauth RCE & critical-function abuse (public exploits). CISA Bulletin
Eclipse Arrowhead/Ditto: authorization bypass & SSRF impacting IIoT & digital twins. CISA Bulletin
Oracle PeopleSoft: mass exploitation (CVE-2026-35273) with WAF bypasses via URL encoding. KrebsOnSecurity

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190): PHP2Shell, NetScaler/ICS vulns, PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273.
Valid Accounts & Credential Access (T1078/T1003): edge/VPN creds; Zimbra app passwords; browser/db creds theft (FlashHole).
Living off the Land (PowerShell/WMI/WinRM) (T1059/T1047/T1021.006): ransomware affiliates and APT intrusion flows.
Web Shell (T1505.003): PHP and appliance web backdoors; Node-RED HTTP-exec flows on IoT2050.
Exfiltration over Web Services/DNS (T1567/T1048.003): Dropbox/GitHub C2; DNS-based exfil in Zimbra campaigns.
Network Device Configuration Dump via SNMP/SMI; default credentials and weak hashing (router hygiene advisory).

outlook72h: Expect ongoing automated scanning/exploitation of PHP2Shell; prioritize patch windows for all public PHP services; apply virtual patching immediately. Hunt for newly deployed Node-RED flows and suspicious exec patterns on Siemens IoT2050; isolate any anomalous devices. Run emergency integrity checks and compromise assessments on NetScaler/ICS appliances; expire sessions and rotate secrets post-patch. Validate EPICS CA/pvAccess exposure from DMZ and partner networks; implement strict ACLs and monitoring. Increase monitoring on refrigeration/building automation segments for abnormal setpoint changes; prepare rollback and manual overrides.
